SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.channels, c.target_group, c.holdout_pct, c.mailing_list_size, c.holdout_size,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS h_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS h_distinct,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS contacted_members
FROM dim_campaign c ORDER BY campaign_id

calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
c AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS holdout,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM c)) AS overlap_contacted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) AS not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from<='2025-11-24' AND valid_to>='2025-11-24' AND marketing_consent)) AS consent_at_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS contacted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) AS bak_rows,
 (SELECT holdout_size FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) AS bak_holdout,
 (SELECT mailing_list_size FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) AS bak_list
